My dear [Sir](../persons.html#1143),

Many thanks for the three critiques on Mlle Mori which I hope to shew [Miss Roberts](../persons.html#1244).

I think there is a good deal of one sidedness in the [Literary Gazette](../others.html#143)- as though written by a person who saw from only one point of view.

I cannot judge whether the characters are too English but I fully believe Miss Roberts had authority for some of the things here represented as impossible and I wonder whether the writer has any grounds for the ‘simply not true’, that the hero and heroine were unlikely to receive alms because not Roman Catholics.

yours with thanks

CMYonge
